After NEC

NEC graduates shape the world through music.

  • Stephanie Economou ’12

    Stephanie Economou ’12 Changes the Game in Hollywood

    NEC Major: Composition

    About Stephanie: Violinist and composer for film, television and video games.

    In the News: First-ever winner of a Grammy for video game composition for Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: Dawn of Ragnarök.

    Passion Project: Empowering women’s voices through The Alliance for Women Film Composers.

  • Evren Ozel ’21, ’23 MM, ’25 AD

    Evren Ozel ’21, ’23 MM, ’25 AD Honors his Musical Heritage

    NEC Major: Piano

    About Evren: Performed internationally with ensembles including The Cleveland Orchestra, RTÉ National Symphony, and the Boston Pops.

    In the News: Winner of a 2023 Avery Fisher Career Grant for those with potential for significant careers in classical music.

    Passion Project: Wants to self-produce a recording of Chopin’s Mazurkas in honor of his mother and stepfather, a former concert pianist.

  • Anthony León ’21 MM

    Anthony León ’21 MM Hits an Early Career High Note

    NEC Major: Vocal Performance

    About Anthony: Sings tenor with the Los Angeles Opera.

    In the News: Won the 2023 Metropolitan Opera’s Eric and Dominique Laffont Competition for promising young opera singers.

    Passion Project: Member of the Domingo-Colburn-Stein Young Artist Program at the LA Opera for 2022-23 season.

  • Brittany Bryant ’23 Enna, Sicily

    Brittany Bryant ’23 Takes an Uncharted Path

    NEC Major: Vocal Performance

    About Brittany: Explores the intersection of linguistics, culture, and music.

    In the News: One of the first NEC undergraduates to receive a Fulbright fellowship to study in Enna, Sicily.

    Passion Project: Fulbright research focuses on the evolution of gender-neutral terminology in the Italian language.

  • Lina González-Granados ’14 MM, ’15 GD Philadelphia, PA

    Lina González-Granados ’14 MM, ’15 GD Brings Raw Power to the Podium

    NEC Major: Conducting

    About Lina: Resident conductor for the Los Angeles Opera.

    In the News: In a profile, the Los Angeles Times said, “it’s as if the music is alive inside her body.”

    Passion Project:Dedicated to highlighting new and unknown works by Latin-American composers.

Join Our Ensemble

Campaign for Future of Music Education

It’s a big moment in music education, and we need you.

You don’t have to play an instrument. You don’t have to know how to read music. This campaign is about advancing humanity through music. It’s about expanding the possibilities of what music can be. It’s about making sure everyone has access to listening and learning.

Together, we can unleash the power of music.
